raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add the opt-in `mi355x_agentx_tp8` preset to the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe: the TP8, concurrency-1 AgentX point from [InferenceX #4666](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4666), served with `--monokernel` on a nightly that carries [#64101](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64101) (mono decode at TP8 on MI355X).

## Claims

- Adds one preset with one point (concurrency 1, TP8) for MI355X, pinned to `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-335dd77b09161c5d63139b4e7ae51bb9928305b1@sha256:3c634cc2…7291`.
- The generated command carries the same serving flags as the InferenceX run; the TP8 point keeps `--monokernel` and GPU-resident Engram tables (`cpu_offload: false`), with one sequence at a time and 32768-token prefill chunks, as the TP4 concurrency-1 point does.
- The runbook documents that TP8 mono is a concurrency-1 configuration and needs a build with #64101.
- No existing rendering changes.

## Validation

From a `vllm-project/recipes` checkout at `d460fcc`, with this branch as the `vllm` source:

```bash
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir "$VLLM_CHECKOUT/recipes"
node --test scripts/test-guide-html.mjs scripts/test-presets.mjs scripts/test-schema.mjs
```

The source validator passes and 47 of 47 renderer tests pass. Building the JSON API on `main` and on this branch gives 22,575 identical files; the only differences are the new `presets/mi355x_agentx_tp8.json` and the new entry in the two parent recipe JSONs (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.json`, `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.json`).

The rendered TP8 command was compared flag by flag with the `vllm serve` command in the InferenceX job log. Every serving flag matches; the only differences are harness flags (`--host`, `--port`, `--device-ids`, `--served-model-name`, `--disable-uvicorn-access-log`) and `--max-model-len 1048576`, which equals the recipe's `context_length`.

Existing GPU evidence, not a new GPU run from this PR:

| Evidence | Configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [InferenceX run 41098938196](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41098938196), `fa9d48627` | MI355X TP8 concurrency-1 performance point, nightly-335dd77b | Passed: 362 of 373 requests, interactivity p50 696.9 / p90 685.5 tokens/s/user, TTFT p50 0.17 s (single run) |
| Same run, GSM8K | TP8 concurrency 1, real block rejection | 0.972 strict exact match, 1,319 samples |

`pre-commit run typos` flags `UE8M0` at line 1306 of this file. That line is not in this diff and the same failure occurs on `main`.

## Details

**Not a duplicate.** I found no open or merged PR that adds a TP8 preset for this recipe; #63665, #63344 and #63560 cover the TP2/TP4 `mi355x_agentx` preset, and #64589 adds an unrelated MI325X preset. This preset is separate from `mi355x_agentx` because `source` (InferenceX key and revision) is per preset, and this lane has its own key, revision and image pin.

**Limits.** #64101 validated TP8 mono with six DSpark drafts; this lane runs five (the recipe's value), measured by the InferenceX run above. The preset makes no claim beyond concurrency 1. The `mi355x_agentx` preset is untouched.

The preset is placed at the end of the presets block, away from the MI325X preset proposed in #64589, to avoid a textual conflict between the two.

AI assistance was used (Claude Sonnet 5.5, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, via Claude Code): it drafted the preset, ran the validation above and compared the rendered command with the InferenceX job log. The submitter reviewed the changes.

files.patch:
@@ -1067,6 +1067,55 @@ presets:
           - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,42,48,54,60,66,72,78,84,90,96,102,108,114,120,126,132,138,144,150,156,162,168,174,180,186,192,198,204,210,216,222,228,234,240],"max_cudagraph_capture_size":240}'
           - "--no-enable-prefix-caching"
 
+  mi355x_agentx_tp8:
+    label: "AgentX TP8 conc 1"
+    hardware: mi355x
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    # Same checkpoint note as mi355x_agentx: the lane served the 0909 launch
+    # checkpoint, and 1017 shares its format and memory layout.
+    variants: [fp8, default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "TP8 at concurrency 1 with mono decode and resident Engram tables: one sequence at a time and 32768-token prefill chunks, as the TP4 concurrency-1 point, on a nightly that carries mono decode at TP8."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4666", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4666", key: "dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark-tp8-c1", revision: fa9d48627d37b236ca6401505da2626bfe469cb2 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-335dd77b09161c5d63139b4e7ae51bb9928305b1@sha256:3c634cc2c51eda7eb840a236b1f09a5ecf6a4b0cb92c4b8486e2158770507291"
+    tp: 8
+    select:
+      frontend: rust
+      features: { spec_decoding: true, text_only: true, encoder_parallel: false }
+    args:
+      - "--max-num-seqs"
+      - "1"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "32768"
+      - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+      - "8"
+    env:
+      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
+    json_args:
+      "--engram-config": { cpu_offload: false }
+    points:
+      tp8_c1:
+        label: "1"
+        concurrency: 1
+    runbook: |
+      `--monokernel` runs at TP8 only on builds that carry
+      [vllm-project/vllm#64101](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64101)
+      (merged 2026-10-29); earlier builds refuse it outside TP2 and TP4. The pinned
+      nightly is 17 commits past that merge.
+
+      TP8 mono is a concurrency-1 configuration. #64101 measured one TP8 server at
+      concurrency 4 with 26% lower throughput than two TP4 replicas, so serve TP4 or
+      TP2 replicas, as the `mi355x_agentx` preset does, once more than one request is
+      in flight.
+
+      [InferenceX run 41098938196](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41098938196)
+      passed its concurrency-1 performance point and GSM8K evaluation at `fa9d48627`.
+      The performance point completed 362 of 373 requests with interactivity p50 696.9
+      and p90 685.5 tokens/s/user and TTFT p50 0.17 s (single run). The evaluation
+      scored 0.972 exact match (strict) over 1319 questions. Throughput runs use
+      DSpark's synthetic golden acceptance length (3.51); the preset keeps real block
+      rejection for ordinary serving and accuracy evaluation.
+
 hardware_notes:
   dgx_station_gb300:
     title: "Weights in Grace memory (UVA offload)"
